title: One Star. One Burned Kitchen. Zero Chill.
caption:
POV: your duo sets the kitchen on fire mid-order
She begs him to plate the soup, he swears he's trying, and their in-game kitchen erupts in flames before the timer runs out.
Co-op games turn best friends into screaming chefs in under two minutes.
Who's the chaotic one in your gaming duo?
Share this with the friend who always burns the kitchen.
